title: Set up the email service, so invites and rundowns are actually sent

intro.verdict_html: Production has no email key, so a team invite is never emailed (the page shows the link to you instead) and weekly rundown emails cannot go out. Resend's free plan is enough: 3,000 emails a month, 100 a day. This is the one thing the partner's invite waits on.
prerequisites: Access to the DNS for sporebit.com (to prove the domain is yours)
time: 15 minutes, plus up to an hour for DNS to settle

steps.title: Create the account
steps.body_html: Sign up with your own email. No card is asked for on the free plan.

steps.title: Add the sending domain
steps.body_html: Add sporebit.com. Resend shows three or four DNS records (SPF, DKIM, and optionally DMARC). Add each at your DNS host exactly as shown, then press Verify. It can take up to an hour.

notes.html: Invites are sent from invites@sporebit.com. No inbox is needed for that address: it only sends.

steps.title: Create the key

where.label: Resend → API Keys → Create API Key

steps.body_html: Name: Mycelium production. Permission: Sending access. Domain: sporebit.com. Copy the key: it is shown once.

notes.html: The key goes into Vercel in the next step and nowhere else. Do not paste it into this checklist or a chat.

steps.title: Add the variable
steps.body_html: Add a variable named as below, value = the key, Environment: Production. Save, then Deployments → the latest → Redeploy (a variable only takes effect on a new deployment).

steps.title: Send yourself an invite
steps.body_html: Invite one of your own other addresses to any team as a viewer. The page should say Invite created. with no link shown, and the email should arrive within a minute, not in spam. Then delete the test member.

troubleshooting.symptom: The page still shows the invite link
troubleshooting.cause: The app was not redeployed after the variable was added, or the variable is on Preview only.
troubleshooting.fix: Check it is on Production, then Redeploy.

troubleshooting.cause: The domain is not verified yet, or DMARC is missing.
troubleshooting.fix: Wait for Verified in Resend; add the DMARC record it suggests.
